mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '开票' AS item, SUM(total_amount) AS amount FROM invoice WHERE status = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} UNION ALL SELECT '回款' AS item, SUM(amount) FROM receipt AND DATE_FORMAT(receipt_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} UNION ALL SELECT '应收未收' AS item, COALESCE(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) FROM sales_order WHERE status = 1 ) t
